summary: Asks you a few quick questions, then sets up a small team of helpers for you to approve.
hello: Hi, I'm {{name}}! I'll set up a small team of helpers for you. Just a few quick questions: tap an answer, or type your own.
again: Let's set up your team again. A few quick questions, like before.
change: No problem, let's go through it again.
skipped: Okay, it's just me for now. You can set up your team any time in Settings, under Agents & brains.

help.text: What do you want help with first?

chat.text: Do you also want to talk to your helpers from a chat app?

options.new: Make a new email (I'll guide you)

askFirst.text: Last one: is there anything they must always ask you about first?

plan.intro: Here is the team I will set up. Approve it, or change it.
plan.base: Reply in the language the person writes in. Keep answers short and plain. Always ask the owner before spending money, sending messages to other people or deleting anything.
plan.detail: What the owner told you about it: {{what}}

shop.job: Handles orders and customer questions for your shop.

money.job: Keeps track of sales, costs and who still owes you.

home.job: Plans meals, schedules and reminders for the family.

work.job: Drafts messages, keeps notes and tracks your to-dos.

study.job: Explains lessons, quizzes you and keeps you on schedule.

mail.job: Sorts your email and drafts replies for you to check.
mail.why: your email, with a short guided setup

steps.email-new: Make a new email together, step by step
steps.people: Invite the people who will use it

askFirst.money: Also ask the owner before any spending, however small.
askFirst.contact: Also ask the owner before contacting anyone.
askFirst.files: Also ask the owner before changing any of their files.
askFirst.custom: Also always ask the owner first about: {{what}}

plan.language: The owner chose {{language}}: always reply in that language unless they ask for another one.
plan.taglish: The owner chose Taglish: reply in Taglish, a natural, casual mix of Filipino and English, unless they ask for another language.

team.ready: Your team is ready! Open a helper to say hi.

web.typeOwn: Or type your own answer below.
web.planTitle: Here is the team I will set up
web.stepsTitle: Setup steps I will open for you
web.secretsNote: Passwords and codes go only on those setup pages, never in a chat.
web.ownerOnly: Only the owner can answer this.

settings.title: Set up my team
settings.hint: Answer a few questions and get a team of helpers
settings.keywords: team, setup, helpers, interview, start over, orchestrator
settings.body: Your team builder asks a few short questions, then shows a plan for you to approve.
settings.noBrain: Set up a brain first, then try again.

stage.title: Set up your team
stage.slow: This is taking longer than usual.
stage.skipped: Okay, we can finish setting up your team later. Open Settings and tap “Continue my team setup” to pick up where you left off.

welcome.title: Hi! Let’s build your own team of helpers.
welcome.body: I’ll ask a few easy questions, then set up helpers that do the work for you. About 2 minutes.

lang.title: Which language should your helpers speak?
lang.body: Anong wika ang gusto mo? Everything after this uses your pick.
lang.sample: Hi! What can I help you with today?

name.title: What will you call me?
name.body: I’ll lead your team. “{{name}}” is the default, but it’s up to you.
name.label: Your main helper’s name

errors.long: That name is too long. Use up to {{max}} letters.
errors.bad: Use plain letters only, without special marks.
errors.taken: That name is taken. Try another one.

q.sub: Tap one, or tell me in your own words.
q.subMulti: Pick as many as you like, or tell me in your own words.

plan.title: Here is the team I will set up for you
plan.lead: I’m the lead. You talk to me, and I give them their tasks.

people.team: My team at work uses it too

email.new: A new email, made together step by step

done.title: Your team is ready!
done.body: They’re all set. Just talk to {{name}}, who takes care of the rest.

next.title: Next step
next.new: {{name}} will help you make your new email, one step at a time, in your chat.
next.connect: Connect your email now. It takes about 3 minutes.

summary.body: Your team is set up! Here is what you told me, and your helpers.

summaryLead: Looks after your team: passes each job to the right helper, and can add or change helpers when you ask.

oks.title: A few things need your OK
oks.sub: {{name}} and the team can do more with these. Each one is your choice, and nothing turns on until you tap.

email.title: Connect your email
email.why: So the mail helper can read new mail and tell you what matters.

chat.title: Connect {{app}}
chat.why: So you can talk to your helpers in {{app}} too.

apps.title: Connect {{app}}
apps.why: Your helpers can use {{app}} for you once it’s connected.

browser.title: Let helpers use their own browser
browser.why: They open websites in a separate browser you can watch. They never sign in or pay for you.

computer.title: Let a helper use this computer
computer.why: It could see the screen and use the mouse and keyboard. It asks you first every time.

ask.title: Choose how often helpers ask first
ask.why: Pick when they check with you before acting. Money and messages always ask.

alerts.title: Get a ping when a helper needs you
alerts.why: We’ll tell you on this device when something needs your OK.

oks.opened: Opened. Finish it on that page
oks.later: Later: {{name}} will remind you in the chat
